title: 1-BYM-2026 Rammeavtale for utendørs montering av belysning og andre elektriske installasjoner
description: Oslo kommune ved Bymiljøetaten (heretter kalt Oppdragsgiver) har ansvar for å forvalte, drifte og utvikle kommunale byrom i Oslo, inkludert veier, gater, sykkel- og turveier, parker, friområder, idretts- og friluftsanlegg, samt områder i Marka og Indre Oslofjord. Etaten skal sørge for rene, trygge og tilgjengelige byrom med godt vedlikehold, belysning og avfallshåndtering. Bymiljøetatens mål er å gjøre Oslo til en trygg, vakker, grønn og aktiv by for alle. Oppdragsgiver skal inngå parallelle rammeavtaler, for utendørs montering ev belysning og andre elektriske installasjoner, med to til tre leverandører forutsatt at vi får nok kvalifiserte tilbydere. Rammeavtalen skal erstatte dagens tilsvarende rammeavtale som utløper 28.11.2026. Rammeavtalen skal dekke behovet for utendørs montering av belysning og andre elektriske installasjoner, ved oppgradering av eksisterende anlegg og etablering av nyanlegg. Kontraktsarbeidene skal omfatte elektriske tjenester, primært for belysningsinstallasjoner (lysarmaturer og styresystem). Rammeavtalen skal også dekke andre elektrofag som blant annet arrangementstrøm, opparbeidelse av infrastruktur og montering av belysningsarmaturer, inkluderer belysning av gater, torg og møteplasser, parker, grøntområder og idrettsanlegg samt belysning i marka. Rammeavtalen skal dekke levering av enkelte varer, blant annet master og fundament. Andre etater, foretak og bydelene i Oslo kommune skal kunne benytte rammeavtalen. I de tilfeller dette vil være aktuelt vil avrop bli utført av Oppdragsgiver. Alle ytelser som utføres på rammeavtalen skal utføres innenfor Oslo kommunes grense samt områder i marka og indre Oslofjord som forvaltes av Oslo kommune. Rammeavtalen er ikke-eksklusiv, som betyr at Oppdragsgiver står derfor fritt til å anskaffe tilsvarende tjenester fra andre leverandører. Leverandørene er forpliktet til å levere i henhold til kontrakt. Omorganiseringer i Oslo kommune kan forekomme i kontraktsperioden og kan påvirke ansvaret for forvaltningsoppgavene til Oppdragsgiver. Det kan påvirke hvilken etat, foretak og/eller bydel i Oslo kommune som vil være Oppdragsgiver i kontraktsperioden. Avtalen har en årlig estimert verdi på inntil 30 millioner NOK. Oppdragsgiver gjør oppmerksom på at estimatet er basert på tidligere forbruk og forventet fremtidig behov. Estimatet er kun retningsgivende og innebærer ingen forpliktelse for Oppdragsgiver. Mengder og volum kan endres i løpet av kontraktsperioden og er avhengig av blant annet budsjettmidler. Rammeavtalen avgrense mot driftskontraktene og skal ikke dekke løpende driftsoppgaver. Kontraktsperioden for rammeavtalen er inntil fire år fra oppstart. Tentativ oppstartsdato er 1.12.2026. Nærmere dato vil bli angitt i rammeavtalen. Maksimal verdi for alle avrop på rammeavtalen er på 120 MNOK. Kontraktsarbeider som skal utføres ved avrop på rammeavtalen ansees som tjenesteleveranser og avtaleforholdet blir regulert av Standard kontraktsvilkår for Oslo kommunes kjøp av håndverkertjenester med eventuelle suppleringer og endringer som framkommer i kontraktsformular for Oslo kommunes kjøp av håndverkertjenester. Bestemmelser vil suppleres med Oppdragsgivers spesifisering av oppdraget for det enkelte avrop og leverandørens besvarelse/tilbud. Varighet på avropene vil bli fastsatt for hvert enkelt avrop. Avropsavtale kan utløpe etter at kontraktsperioden for rammeavtalen er utløpt. For nærmere beskrivelse av leveranser og krav i rammeavtalen se alle vedleggene i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet (KGV). ----------------------------------------

title: Rehabilitering av fasader - Valhalla Helsesenter (NS 8407) - 2. Utlysning
description: Kristiansand kommune skal utføre fasaderenovering av Valhalla helsesenter. Tilstandsanalyse viser at fasaden har omfattende fuktskader og manglende lufting. Det skal utføres total rehabilitering av fasade, vinduer og dører, samt solavskjerming.Det er utført tilstandsanalyse av fasadekonstruksjonen, tilstandsbetegnelsen er satt til TG 3 – stort eller alvorlig avvik.Valhalla helsesenter er oppført i 1998. Bygget fungerer i dag som et helsesenter med følgende funksjoner:Valhalla helsesenter gir døgnbehandling med opphold av kortere varighet. Det er ingen faste sykehjemsplasser her.Helsesenteret tilbyr korttidsplasser, rehabilitering og Øyeblikkelig hjelp-døgnopphold (ØHD).Helsesenteret har totalt 78 plasser. 14 senger for rehabilitering, 56 senger for korttid og 8 senger ved ØHD. Det er tverrfaglig samarbeid mellom sykepleiere, fagarbeidere, leger, fysioterapeuter og ergoterapeuter. Helsesenteret har eget renholdspersonell. I husets 1. etasje i tilknytning til ØHD-avdelingen, holder kommunalt responssenter (24-timers drift), legevaktsentral og kommunens ambulerende blodprøvetakingstjeneste til. Bygget vil være i full drift under hele byggeprosessen, noe som krever god prosjektledelse for å minimere forstyrrelser. Se vedlegg 24 - Informasjon om konsekvenser for drift, og 24.1 - Fase inndeling, hvor oppdragsgiver forsøker å gi et bilde av problemstillinger det må tas hensyn til i planleggingen.

title: Konsulentbistand ved oppstart av Enova SFs nye svartjeneste
description: Enovas viktigste virkemiddel er investeringsstøtte til prosjekter, enten det er til store prosjekter i industrien eller til mindre tiltak i husholdningene. Enova skal forvalte felleskapets midler slik at disse gir størst mulig nytte for samfunnet. Gjennom å dekke en del av merkostnadene som markedet pådrar seg ved å velge mer energi- og klimavennlige løsninger, skal Enova bidra til å løfte frem klimaprosjekter. Enova driver også med veiledning. Enovas svartjeneste har vært driftet eksternt i over 20 år. Enova er nå i prosess med å håndtere denne tjenesten med egne ansatte. I mindre prosjekter gis det informasjon og råd, fortrinnsvis om Enovas støttetilbud, på Enovas nettsider, gjennom nyhetsbrev og Enovas veiledningstjeneste. Enova ønsker å inngå avtale om kjøp av konsulentbistand i forbindelse med etablering og drift av Enova SFs nye svartjeneste. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at Enova har tilstrekkelig kompetanse og kapasitet til å håndtere henvendelser og opplæring i en overgangsperiode frem til intern svartjeneste er fullt operativ. Oppdraget inkluderer konsulentbistand til veiledning rundt Enovas støttetilbud og Energimerkeordningen samt noe veiledning på temaer innenfor Enovas arbeidsområder. Ved utførelsen av oppdraget skal leverandøren betjene avtalte inn- og utgående henvendelser for Enova i tråd med svartjenestens fastsatte krav til kundestatistikk, inkludert svartid og kundetilfredshet. Konsulentene vil inngå i Enovas nyetablerte veiledningstjeneste, og arbeidsmetodikk og krav til tjenesten satt av Enova vil følges av konsulentene. Konsulentenes kontorsted kan være et annet enn Trondheim, men enkelte reiser til Trondheim i avtaleperioden må påregnes. Det estimeres et omfang for avtalen tilsvarende inntil 2 FTE (fulltidsekvivalenter) i perioden fra 01.03.27 til 31.12.27. Se konkurransegrunnlaget for en nærmere beskrivelse av oppdraget.

title: Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) License and Services
description: The Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) has a requirement for the provision of Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) licences and related services to allow facility managers to create unique workflows to address maintenance activities on their property. The requirement includes: • Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) Software as a Service (SaaS) Licenses. • Basic Installation Support on how to use the system’s features. • The delivery of virtual User Training and support and, • An Optional Data Transfer – to be determined depending on operational requirements The resulting contract is anticipated to be awarded for an initial period of one (1) year plus four (4) one-year option periods.

title: Environmental Consultant Services in Nunavut
description: English Title: CR26SL01, Environmental Consultant Services for contaminated sites, environmental compliance and DSS/Hazmat in Nunavut. English Description: Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is calling for Abbreviated Proposals from engineering consulting firms to establish a Source List (SL) in support of the Department of National Defence (DND) requirements to provide “as and when required” the following professional services at various locations in Nunavut: Environmental Site Assessment (ESA), Monitoring and Remediation projects, including all stages of the Federal Approach to Contaminated Sites and/or DND's Contaminated Site Remediation Framework. Natural Resources Consultant Services Infrastructure-related environmental compliance monitoring, audits, and inspections, and providing advice, including Class D estimates and conceptual designs, on infrastructure-related environmental management issues (in accordance with pertinent regulations and/or guidelines) in support of DND Operations. Designated Substance Surveys (DSS) and Hazardous Materials (Hazmat) Assessment Specialties Services. (i.e. Archaeological Assessments) This procurement is subject to the Agreement Between the Inuit of the Nunavut Settlement Area and Her Majesty the Queen in Right of Canada (the Nunavut Agreement), and the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat’s Directive on Government Contracts (including real property leases) in the Nunavut Settlement Area. DCC has confirmed that there are two (2) or more Inuit Firms on the Inuit Firm Registry that could potentially provide the required services. In accordance with the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat’s Directive on Government Contracts (including real property leases) in the Nunavut Settlement Area, Proponents are advised that bidding for this solicitation is therefore restricted to qualified Inuit Firms that are registered and in good standing with the Inuit Firm Registry. Canada’s free trade agreements pose no impediment to the inclusion of measures including set asides, for the benefit of Indigenous Peoples and businesses in a procurement. This applies to procurement obligations pursuant to all Modern Treaties (Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements). Information provided by the Proponents will be evaluated using the established criteria in the RFAP. The objective of this RFAP is to select the three (3) Proponents with the highest total scores. The criteria include Inuit and Nunavut benefits for Inuit employment, Inuit training and skills development, subcontracting to Inuit firms, and the location of offices/facilities in the NSA. The SL will be for a period of two (2) years with a maximum estimated value of $ 15,000,000.00. Subject to whether the Consultants are Inuit Firms that are still registered and in good standing on the Inuit Firm Registry, and if mutually agreeable between the Consultant and DCC, the SL may be extended for up to three (3) additional one (1) year periods and increased in the order of $15,000,000.00 at any time during the term of the SL and at DCC’s sole discretion. Individual Commissions under the SL are expected to be valued between $ 200,000.00 and $ 1,500,000.00; with no maximum value of a commission. Refer to the RFAP document for additional information. Firms that consider themselves qualified to provide these services are invited to submit their Abbreviated Proposals through the MERX Electronic Bidding System on or before the closing date and time indicated on the Electronic Bidding System. The selected consultants will be required to hold a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS), issued by the Contract Security Program (CSP) within Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).  Details concerning the Security Requirements for this project are identified in the RFAP documents. Questions regarding this solicitation are to be directed ONLY to the point of contact identified in this advertisement.  Proponents who address their questions to anyone other than the point of contact during the solicitation period may, for that reason alone, be disqualified. Please note that the preliminary results for this solicitation will be available on MERX. title: Design and Construction of a Modular Office Complex, CFB Edmonton
description: DEFENCE CONSTRUCTION CANADA (DCC) is requesting Proposals from Design-Build Teams to design and construct a new 250-person modular office complex at CFB Edmonton following a modified design-build approach. Additional details are provided in the Request for Proposals (RFP) documents. The estimated construction cost for this opportunity is in the range of $14.8 million. Firms that consider themselves qualified to provide these services are invited to submit their proposals through the MERX Electronic Bidding System on or before the closing date and time indicated on the Electronic Bidding System. This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Chapter Nineteen of the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA). The selected contractor will be required to hold a valid Designated Organization Screening (DOS), issued by the Contract Security Program (CSP) within Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC).  Details concerning the Security Requirements for this project are identified in Amendment No.1 to the RFP documents. Questions regarding this solicitation are to be directed ONLY to the point of contact identified in this advertisement.  Bidders who address their questions to anyone other than the point of contact during the solicitation period may, for that reason alone, be disqualified. Bidders can obtain contract award results from the DCC website at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/contract-activity. DCC now publicly discloses information on payments made to prime contractors so that subcontractors know when they can expect payment. Information on payments made in the past 90 days on construction contracts over $100,000, as well as further information regarding DCC’s prompt payment commitment, can be obtained from the DCC website This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1240LT26Q0175 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Drilling and developing a new domestic water well and construction of a water distribution line. Project Location: 12782 Nemo Road, Nemo, Lawrence County, South Dakota 57759 This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 237110 Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction The small business size standard is $45M This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. FAR 52.228-1 Bid Bond/Offer Guarantee: A bid bond/offer guarantee shall be submitted at time of offer on a Standard Form 24 (SF24), Failure to provide the bid bond will render the offer non-responsive, resulting in its rejection. The required guarantee amount is 20% of the total offer price, not to exceed a maximum of $3 million. Alternative Payment Protections FAR 52.228-13 (July 2000) (a) The Contractor shall submit the following payment protections: Payment Bonds (b) The amount of the payment protection shall be 100% of the contract price. (c) The submission of the payment protection is required within 10 days of contract award. (d) The payment protection shall provide protection for the full contract performance period plus a one-year period. (e) Except for escrow agreements and payment bonds, which provide their own protection procedures, the Contracting Officer is authorized to access funds under the payment protection when it has been alleged in writing by a supplier of labor or material that a nonpayment has occurred, and to withhold such funds pending resolution by administrative or judicial proceedings or mutual agreement of the parties. The United States Air Force (USAF) has a requirement in support of Headquarters Air Force Civil Engineer Center (HQ AFCEC), Fire and Emergency Services Division for the purchase of Fire and Emergency Services (F&ES) Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Ensemble (complete set of protective gear, consisting of one coat and one pair of pants, and (1) particulate blocking hood. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 4240 � Safety and Rescue Equipment. Additionally, NAICS code 314999 � All Other Miscellaneous Textile Product Mills is being considered. The small business size standard for this NAICS is 550 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 8415 � Clothing, Special Purpose Orders will fluctuate dependent on the USAF�s needs, but the current estimate is based on a quantity of 11,000 Ensemble sets over the anticipated 5-year ordering period. title: Building 215 Clean Room HEPA Filter Replacement
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) BUILDING 215 ADVANCED MEASUREMENT LABORATORY (AML) CLEANROOM REPAIR AND HEPA FILTER REPLACEMENT Solicitation/Reference No.: 1333ND26RNB190014 1. PURPOSE OF THIS REQUEST FOR INFORMATION The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is conducting market research pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10 and FAR 15.201 to obtain industry feedback concerning the scope, schedule, phasing, cleanroom outage requirements, technical and performance risks, and estimated construction cost associated with the Building 215 Advanced Measurement Laboratory (AML) Cleanroom Repair and HEPA Filter Replacement project. NIST previously solicited this requirement under Solicitation No. 1333ND26RNB190014. NIST did not receive an acceptable offer under that solicitation. NIST is therefore reassessing the requirement and acquisition approach before determining whether and how to resolicit the project. NIST is particularly interested in identifying aspects of the requirement that may materially affect industry participation, constructability, schedule feasibility, pricing, risk, or the ability of contractors to submit competitive proposals. Industry is encouraged to provide candid feedback and to identify recommended changes that could improve constructability, competition, schedule feasibility, cost certainty, and overall project execution while continuing to meet NIST�s mission and cleanroom operational requirements. 2. RFI / MARKET RESEARCH NOTICE THIS RFI IS ISSUED SOLELY FOR INFORMATION AND ACQUISITION PLANNING PURPOSES. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP), INVITATION FOR BID (IFB), REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ), OR OTHER SOLICITATION. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on responses to this RFI. Responses will be treated as information only and shall not be construed as offers or proposals that can be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting information in response to this RFI or for participating in any follow-up discussions. This RFI does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government�s ultimate acquisition approach. Respondents are advised that information submitted in response to this RFI may be used by NIST in developing or revising the acquisition strategy, statement of work, specifications, schedule, phasing requirements, outage requirements, Government cost estimate, and future solicitation. Respondents should clearly identify and mark any proprietary, confidential, or commercially sensitive information contained in their responses. Respondents should avoid including proprietary information unless necessary to provide a meaningful response. 3. PROJECT BACKGROUND The project involves repair and modernization work within the Building 215 Advanced Measurement Laboratory cleanroom located at the NIST Gaithersburg Campus. The AML cleanroom encompasses approximately 1,800 square meters and includes approximately 750 square meters of Class 100 cleanroom space. The facility supports sensitive NIST research activities and contains specialized and, in some instances, irreplaceable scientific equipment. The project generally includes, but is not limited to: Replacement of approximately 1,200 terminal supply HEPA filters; Repair and/or modification of HEPA filter connections; Testing, balancing, certification, and recertification of affected HEPA filters and cleanroom spaces; Replacement of approximately 70 variable air volume (VAV) terminal units; Replacement of approximately 54 airflow monitoring devices; Installation of approximately 32 exhaust air control valves; Modification and repair of associated ductwork; Rebalancing of associated air-handling and exhaust systems; Verification and repair, as required, of existing capped ductwork; Controls-related work; Cleaning, testing, balancing, commissioning, and cleanroom certification associated with each affected area; and Protection of existing cleanroom spaces, research operations, and sensitive scientific equipment throughout construction. Detailed project drawings, specifications, and/or relevant portions of the previously issued solicitation may be attached to this RFI or otherwise made available through SAM.gov for purposes of industry review. 4. CURRENT PHASING AND OUTAGE CONCEPT NIST�s previous acquisition strategy was developed to minimize disruption to ongoing research operations by performing the work through phased cleanroom outages rather than shutting down the entire cleanroom for the duration of construction. The previous requirement contemplated 19 construction phases consisting of 18 Critical Cleanroom Outage Phases and one Non-Critical Phase. For each Critical Cleanroom Outage Phase, the contemplated outage period was approximately nine calendar days, generally structured as follows: Outage/construction activities begin at approximately 7:00 p.m. on Friday; Work proceeds continuously, including 24-hour-per-day/seven-day-per-week operations, as necessary; Construction, startup, testing, balancing, cleaning, commissioning, and applicable cleanroom certification are completed during the outage period; and The affected cleanroom area is required to achieve Ready for Re-Occupancy by approximately 7:00 a.m. on the second following Monday. Ready for Re-Occupancy generally means that required construction, startup, testing, balancing, cleaning, commissioning, and applicable cleanroom certification have been completed; the affected area is operationally capable of supporting its intended use without material restriction; and no deficiencies remain that materially impair safe occupancy or cleanroom operations. The previous requirement also contemplated maintaining unaffected cleanroom bays in operation to the maximum extent practicable and included the possibility of limited additional weekend outages affecting larger portions of the cleanroom. NIST recognizes that these operational constraints may significantly affect contractor staffing, sequencing, subcontractor availability, construction risk, pricing, and schedule feasibility. NIST is specifically seeking industry feedback concerning these requirements. 5. INFORMATION REQUESTED FROM INDUSTRY Respondents are requested to review the project information provided with this RFI and address the following topics. Respondents are not required to answer every question; however, detailed and candid responses are encouraged. A. Outage Feasibility and Constraint Identification Critical Path Bottlenecks: Identify the specific trade activities that present the highest risk to achieving a 9-day bay outage window. Realistic Outage Duration: Based on your experience in occupied nanofabrication facilities, what is a realistic, achievable calendar-day duration to complete a single cleanroom bay/module from shutdown to final recertification? Risk & Impact Analysis: Explain how the current 24-hour, 9-day limit impacts project risk, labor density, safety, quality assurance, and total cost (including risk contingencies for $8,000/day liquidated damages). Phasing & Mock-Up Alternatives: Would executing a "mock-up bay" or initial trial phase establish a viable baseline for subsequent production bays? B. Construction Cost Estimate Based on the information provided, what is industry�s rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) estimated construction cost for the complete project? Respondents may provide either a specific estimated amount or a reasonable estimated range. To the extent practicable, please identify the approximate portion of the ROM estimate attributable to: Direct construction work; HVAC/HEPA/VAV work; Controls work; Testing and balancing; Commissioning and cleanroom certification; Premium time, shift work, or 24/7 outage staffing; General conditions; Phasing and temporary protection; Contingency/risk allowance; and Other signi

title: N09.56 MP-210003 - St.Maurice - Pont sur le Rhône - Travaux principaux de renforcement du Pont sur le Rhône - St. Maurice (ID 11814)
description:
Le présent marché concerne les travaux anticipés (mesures VoMa) du pont sur le Rhône à Saint-Maurice situé sur le tronçon d’autoroute N09.56 Bex-Nord – Martigny. Il s’agit de deux ponts haubanés, un par chaussée, qui permettent à l’autoroute N09 de franchir le Rhône entre les tunnels sous l’Arzillier (rive droite) côté Vaud et la tranchée couverte de Saint-Maurice (rive gauche) côté Valais. Ils nécessitent des interventions ciblées de renforcements et de remises en état.

Les interventions comprennent (liste non exhaustive) ; le renforcement et la protection des pylônes au moyen d’un chemisage en composite cimentaire fibré ultra-performant (CFUP) armé, le renforcement de la tête des pylônes avec un caisson métallique et des entretoises précontraintes, l’ajout de tirants d’ancrage en rocher dans les massifs d’ancrage des haubans de retenue, le renforcement de la culée Valais du pont amont au moyen d’une précontrainte externe ainsi que le remplacement des appareils d’appui, le renforcement localisé de la charpente métallique des tabliers et des goussets d’ancrage des haubans, le remplacement du dispositif de retenue sur les ponts et leurs extrémités.

title: Germany – Bridge renewal construction work – Ersatzneubau der Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke in Linnich - Stadt Linnich
description: Ersatzneubau der Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke in Linnich Die Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke wurde 1949 errichtet und war bereits in den Jahren vor dem Hochwasserereignis infolge umfangreicher Schäden und Dauerhaftigkeitsprobleme in den wiederkehrenden Brückenprüfungen nur mit Zustandsnoten von 3,3 bzw. sogar 4,0 bewertet worden. Unmittelbar nach der Flutsituation wurde die Brücke einer Sonderbegut-achtung unterzogen und schließlich gänzlich für den Verkehr gesperrt. Seitdem ist die zentral in Linnich verlaufende Rurstraße unterbrochen und für die Einwohner sowie den Liefer- und Durchgangsverkehr nicht mehr nutzbar. Es besteht daher die Notwendigkeit eines möglichst zügigen Rückbaus der Bestandskonstruktion sowie der Errichtung eines Ersatzneubaus, um die Verkehrswege wieder vollumfänglich nutzen zu können.

title: Netherlands – Playground swings – Leveren van speel en sporttoestellen
description: De Opdracht heeft betrekking op enerzijds het ontwerpen van de speel- en/of sportplek en anderzijds op het leveren, plaatsen en reviseren van sport- en speeltoestellen voor de Gemeente Rotterdam. De Ondernemer dient de onderstaande soorten toestellen en Speelaanleidingen te kunnen leveren: -Speeltoestellen. -Fitness & Calisthenics toestellen. Sporttoestellen om te trainen op uithoudingsvermogen, evenwicht, balans, kracht en mobiliteit. -Specials. Dit zijn speel- of sport toestellen die niet in de catalogus staan en speciaal gemaakt moeten worden. Dit kunnen varianten zijn van bestaande toestellen of nieuw ontworpen toestellen. -Urban sport (zoals free run-,skate, callisthenics, panna, pumptracks, bmx etc.). Opdrachtnemer dient deze Urban sportvoorzieningen wanneer deze onderdeel uitmaken van een integrale inrichting van een speel- en/of sportlocatie, te kunnen ontwerpen en leveren. -Pleinsport toestellen, zoals voetbal, basketbal, volleybal, (tafel)tennis, etc). -Speelaanleidingen, denk hierbij aan een boomstam, randjes, reliëf, belijning, rioolbuizen, wilgen tipi’s, tunnels etc. De Aanbestedende Dienst is voornemens om een overeenkomst te sluiten met maximaal vijf (5) Opdrachtnemers. De totale omvang van de Opdracht bedraagt ca. €3.500.000 per jaar. De begindatum van de Overeenkomst ligt naar verwachting op 1 december 2026. De initiële looptijd van de Overeenkomst is twee (2) jaar, waarna de Overeenkomst maximaal twee (2) maal verlengd kan worden voor de duur van één (1) jaar

title: USACE Sacramento District DB/DBB Construction � $465M Small Business MATOC
description: The United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Sacramento District (SPK), anticipates solicitation of a requirement for design-build (DB) and design-bid-build (DBB) � Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Construction Services in support of SPK�s Military Boundary and Area of Responsibility. Specific needs will be determined based upon project requirements as described in each task order. Selected firms will work on a variety of projects that may include but not necessarily limited to new construction (including new work, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs) of commercial and institutional buildings and related structures. Anticipated work may include the following: new construction, additions, alterations, renovations, repairs, and maintenance of facilities and supporting infrastructure. The Government anticipates establishing a MATOC with a total shared capacity of $465,000,000 with an 8-year ordering period (five-year base with one three-year option period). The Government intends to award up to seven (7) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts. However, The Government reserves the right to award more or fewer than 7 IDIQ contracts if it is determined to be in the best interest of the government. The MATOC will primarily support Military, IIS, DVA, and Civil Works projects for Sacramento District (SPK). The Government currently estimates the magnitude of construction for the task orders to be between $2,500.00 and $20,000,000.00. Contractors will be required to maintain sufficient bonding to cover the value of all awarded task orders. The Government intends to issue a Request for Proposals (RFP) that will result in award of firm-fixed price contracts. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued using North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The small business size standard for this NAICS, as established by the United States Small Business Administration (SBA), is $45,000,000.00 annual revenue. The Product and Service Code (PSC) is anticipated to be Y1JZ (Construction of Miscellaneous Buildings). The solicitation is anticipated to be issued as a total small business set-aside through the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE - https://piee.eb.mil) and Governmentwide Point of Entry, the System for Award Management (SAM - www.SAM.gov) on or about late September 2026, with Phase One proposals tentatively due 30�45 days after issuance. If the Government conducts a pre-proposal conference and/or site visit, the date, time, location, and access requirements will be identified in the forthcoming solicitation. Please DO NOT request an updated schedule if estimated dates are surpassed; the Government will release all information publicly through PIEE and SAM when updates are available. Requests for schedule updates may be ignored. Please DO NOT request a copy of the solicitation, or draft plans and specifications, as they are not currently available. Any available technical data will be furnished with any forthcoming solicitation. Following solicitation release, all responsible sources may submit a proposal that shall be considered by the agency. This project and/or the anticipated solicitation may be changed, delayed, or canceled at any time. The anticipated solicitation and attachments may be posted in Portable Document Format (.pdf) which will require Adobe Acrobat Reader to open and view files. Adobe Acrobat Reader may be downloaded free of charge at http://www.adobe.com/products/reader. All prospective Offerors should be registered in the PIEE system at least one (1) week prior to the anticipated proposal due date. Registration is not required to download any forthcoming solicitation documents, plans, and/or specifications, but IS required to submit a proposal. Copies of the solicitation and attachments will be made available for inspection without charge after the solicitation is released, when accessed through PIEE. Failure to register in PIEE will prevent submission of proposals as the Government will not accept them by any other means. See linked PIEE registration instructions and web-based training for information about how to access the PIEE Solicitation Module and submit proposals. All prospective Offerors must be registered in SAM before the anticipated solicitation closing date. Please see the SAM website for information about SAM registration requirements and approval timelines. It is anticipated that any future solicitation and/or resulting contract will be subject to the E-Verify Employment Eligibility Verification Program (http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify), and sustainable acquisition requirements. USACE will not notify prospective Offerors of any changes to the solicitation; Offerors must monitor PIEE and SAM for the solicitation to be posted, and for any posted changes or amendments. The ONLY Interested Vendors / Plan Holders / Bidders List is available through SAM.gov; Contractors are responsible for identifying their entity as an interested vendor and contacting other interested vendors. Additionally, the DBC will be responsible for providing Construction Surveillance Technicians to ensure construction meets ICD-705 standards in collaboration with the AFCEC team�s SSMs. This integrated, holistic approach is a significant departure from prior MILCON construction norms; our intent is to provide qualified design-builders time to establish expanded partnerships in advance of the Challenge Statement release. The government will accept questions related to this release. Please submit all questions on the GoColosseum Marketplace under the Industry Announcement titled above. The Government reserves the right to respond to questions at its discretion and may not provide responses to all questions submitted 1. Summary of Overall Objective: AFCEC seeks an innovative, highly capable, and experienced partner to serve as the DBC for design and construction of a new C2F warfighting platform at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama. This mission critical facility, and its supporting data center, is required to support approximately 1,800 personnel and cost approximately $4B to design, build, fit-out, commission, accredit, install FF&E. The C2F will incorporate Radio Frequency (RF) shielding, High-Altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP) protection, Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) / Special Access Program (SAP) construction, and redundant and resilient infrastructure. The project will be delivered using a collaborative delivery methodology under the Design Build Institute of America (DBIA) Design Build Done Right framework. This challenge and the resulting agreement are issued pursuant to the Other Transaction Authority (OTA) for military construction projects under 10 U.S.C. � 2808a. This effort is intended to reduce traditional Military Construction (MILCON) delivery timelines by approximately 50%, which the prospective partners should be able to embrace. USSPACECOM completed a Planning Charette Report in June 2026. AFCEC is in the process of hiring an Owner�s Advisor (OA) to support them on the Project Delivery Team (PDT). The DBC will integrate with the established PDT to help AFCEC, their OA, and the USSPACECOM PMO deliver this facility faster, smarter, and with higher mission assurance than any previous Air Force MILCON effort. The Design Builder will be expected to provide innovative approaches and leverage industry standards to take advantage of the OTA authorities and flexibility outside of traditional FAR-based construction to reduce time and cost. Additionally, CSTs will be required to hold TS/SCI clearance Respondents must be Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Level 2 compliant or actively pursuing certification. Während der heutige Hauptsitz der Rega mit Helikopter-Instandhaltungsbetrieb und nationaler Luftrettungszentrale bis Ende 2030 nach Kägiswil verlegt wird, soll die gesamte Ambulanzjet-Operation als eigenständiger Bereich am Flughafen Zürich verbleiben. Die Jet-Basis umfasst im Teilprojekt Hochbau im Wesentlichen einen Hangar mit Platz für drei Ambulanzjets, die dazugehörigen Büroräumlichkeiten sowie die Erschliessung (alle landseitig) mit einer geschätzten Geschossfläche von insgesamt ca. 6'600 m². Im Rahmen der Gesamtleister-Submission ist ein Projektvorschlag sowie das verbindliche Angebot dazu gemäss den Anforderungen der FZAG und der Rega zu erstellen. Die Zusammenstellung des Teams ist dabei dem Anbieter überlassen.

description: Servizio di tesoreria comunale. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

title: Belgium – Survey services – ECOHYDROLOGISCHE STUDIE KIKBEEK en SBZ MECHELSE HEIDE
description: Aanleiding voor de opstart van de ecohydrologische studie zijn de stabiliteitsproblemen in de plas Kikbeek, waardoor de peilstijgingen in functie van bereiken van de instandhoudingsdoelstellingen momenteel niet kunnen doorgaan. Om te onderzoeken wat de effecten zijn van hogere plaspeilen (dan de huidige) in de Kikbeekgroeve op de omliggende grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties is voorwerp van de ecohydrologische studie. Bijkomend wordt onderzocht welke aanvullende maatregelen voor vernatting in het habitatrichtlijngebied de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeekvallei, Neerharerheide en Asbeek noodzakelijk zijn om tot een klimaatrobuust systeem te komen. Doel van de studie is het onderzoek naar de impact op grondwaterstanden en de randvoorwaarden vanuit ecologie door peilstijgingen van de plas Kikbeek en van hydrologische herstelmaatregelen in het de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeek, Neerharerheide en Asbeek. Dit moet leiden tot het maximaliseren van het herstel en de instandhouding van de grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties. Doelstelling is te komen tot klimaatrobuust systeemherstel, zonder de kritieke infrastructuur (zoals de autosnelweg E314) en de stabiliteit van de groeve Berg en de Kikbeekplas op lange termijn te hypothekeren. De opmaak van hydrologische en ecologische modelvoorspellingen moeten dienen om scenario’s voor peilstijging in de plas Kikbeek te onderzoeken en de ontwikkeling van natte natuur in het habitatrichtlijngebied van de Mechelse Heide uit te werken en te evalueren.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – N8 / Lungern Nord – Giswil Süd: Baulos 21 Trassee und Kunstbauten Nord
description: Im Bereich zwischen dem Südportal des bestehenden Tunnels Giswil und dem neuen Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (separate, bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 19) wird die Strasseninfrastruktur erweitert, damit künftig National- und Kantonsstrasse getrennt über zwei separate Trassees geführt werden können. Das heutige Trassee der Brünigstrasse verläuft über die bestehende Buochholzbrücke, am OWi-Land vorbei zum Lungerersee. Die bestehende Buochholzbrücke wird nach Eröffnung des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl für die Nationalstrasse genutzt. Für die Kantonsstrasse wird parallel zur bestehenden Brücke eine neue Strassenbrücke erstellt (separate bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 20). Im vorliegenden Baulos 21 werden die Leistungen für den Lückenschluss zwischen dem Bereich Griffeldossen/Buochholz (Baulos 20) und Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. Die Leistungen umfassen Trasseearbeiten für National- und Kantonsstrasse mit Stützbauwerken sowie einer SABA, einem PW, Geländemodellierungen im Bereich Marchgraben, Wasserbauarbeiten sowie kleinere Kunstbauten. Mit der vorliegenden Beschaffung werden Leistungen für Baumeisterarbeiten für die nachfolgend beschriebenen Hauptarbeiten beschafft: Strassenbau und Werkleitungsbau ------------------------------------------ Neubau Nationalstrasse auf ca. 500 m Länge (insgesamt rund 7'500 m2 Fläche) inkl. ¾-Anschluss Giswil Süd sowie Strassenumbau bestehende Brünigstrasse auf ca. 400 m Länge (insgesamt rund 4'000 m2 Fläche) und Neubau Flurstrassen. Jeweils inkl. Unterbau, Entwässerung Belag und Markierung sowie diverse Werkleitungsumlegungen, -provisorien und -neubauten (u.a. neue Löschwasserleitung für Tunnel Kaiserstuhl). Dazu werden im Perimeter die neue SABA Schwendiboden und das Stapelbecken Nordportal gebaut (Baugrubensicherung mit Rühl- und Nagelwand). Ergänzend werden mit diesem Baulos die Leistungen für den Deckbelagsbau (ca. 16'000 m2) und Markierung (2.1 km Länge) des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. Geländemodellierung und Wasserbau ------------------------------------------ Anpassung des Gerinnes (Ober- und Unterlauf) und des Geschiebesammlers Marchgraben (Blocksteinsohle, ca. 2’500 m2), sowie Neubau flachfundiertes Abschlussbauwerk Marchgraben (Stahlbeton-Durchlass mit 6.2 m Spannweite). Diverse Geländemodellierungsarbeiten im Bereich Marchgraben und Trassee (Abtrag ca. 25'000 m3 und Schüttungen ca. 35'000 m3). Neubau Stützbauwerke und Kunstbauten: ------------------------------------------ Erstellung von zwei je rund 140 m langen, bis zu 9 m hohen Winkelstützmauern inkl. Hinterfüllung (ca. 5’500 m3) und des Portalbauwerks Nord Tunnel Kaiserstuhl im Bereich des neuen N8-Trassees. Baugruben sind bereits in einem Vorlos (Baulos 17a) erstellt worden. Arbeiten teilweise unter Verkehr.

De ce montant, il faut déduire la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € (TVAC) Le montant net de l’offre ne peut par conséquent pas dépasser, par édition, 1.199.999 € (TVAC). En raison de travaux de grande ampleur qui se dérouleront dans le Parc du Cinquantenaire entre 2027 et 2029, l’événement pourrait être organisé selon deux configurations, à savoir : • Scénario 1, privilégié pour les éditions 2027 et 2030 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Schuman) avec le public autour des jardins à la française et dans le parc du Cinquantenaire. • Scénario 2, privilégié pour les éditions 2028 et 2029 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Mérode) avec le public sur l’esplanade côté Mérode, autour du bassin et dans le prolongement de l’avenue de Tervuren ; Le pouvoir adjudicateur ne maitrise pas le planning du chantier dont il n’est pas le maître d’ouvrage et ne peut dès lors pas garantir, à ce stade, que le planning des travaux sera respecté. La mise en œuvre d’un autre scénario que le scénario privilégié pourrait dès lors être envisagé pour l’une ou l’autre édition. Le pouvoir adjudicateur tient à signaler que l’édition 2030 coïncidera avec le bicentenaire de la Belgique.

title: Belgium – Building completion work – PKEA - Marché 01 - organisation de la partie pharmacie / salle blanche
description: Le présent marché est un marché public mixte ayant pour objet l’organisation, l’aménagement et l’équipement de la partie pharmacie / salle blanche, y compris les locaux techniques associés, au sein de la Klinik St. Josef à Saint-Vith. Il comprend deux lots de travaux et un lot principalement de fournitures. Le marché ne porte pas uniquement sur la création d’un environnement contrôlé de type salle blanche, mais également sur l’aménagement complet de la pharmacie hospitalière concernée, de la salle blanche, de leurs locaux techniques associés, ainsi que des équipements, mobiliers, dispositifs techniques, raccordements, finitions et accessoires nécessaires à leur fonctionnement conforme, sécurisé et opérationnel. Le marché comprend l’ensemble des travaux, fournitures, prestations, sujétions et moyens nécessaires à la réalisation complète et conforme des ouvrages, locaux, installations et équipements décrits dans le présent Cahier spécial des charges, dans les clauses techniques, les plans, le métré récapitulatif et les autres documents du marché. Le marché est divisé en trois lots : Lot 1 – Démolitions : comprenant les travaux préparatoires, les démontages, les démolitions, les évacuations, les protections provisoires et toutes prestations nécessaires à la libération des zones concernées par les travaux. Lot 2 – Parachèvements et techniques : comprenant les travaux de parachèvement, les techniques spéciales, les équipements, le mobilier fixe ou intégré et les dispositifs nécessaires à l’aménagement de la pharmacie, de la salle blanche et de leurs locaux techniques associés. Le lot 2 comprend toutes les prestations d’attente, de réservation, de raccordement, d’adaptation, d’interface et de coordination nécessaires à l’intégration des isolateurs relevant du lot 3, dans les limites précisées par les documents du marché. Lot 3 – Isolateurs : comprenant les études d’exécution, la fourniture, la livraison, la manutention, l’installation, les raccordements propres, le paramétrage, la mise en service, les essais, la qualification, la documentation, la formation, la garantie et la maintenance des isolateurs de préparation pharmaceutique, ainsi que toutes les prestations d’interface nécessaires à leur intégration. Approche performancielle applicable aux lots 2 et 3 : Les prescriptions techniques et les postes des bordereaux relatifs au lot 2 et au lot 3 sont, selon les cas, formulés en termes de performances à atteindre, d’exigences fonctionnelles ou d’une combinaison de celles-ci avec des prescriptions techniques, constructives et normatives. Les exigences minimales, performances, résultats, tolérances, conditions d’exploitation, méthodes de vérification et documents probants sont précisés dans les clauses techniques, les plans, les bordereaux et les autres documents du marché. Pour les lots 2 et 3, le soumissionnaire détermine, dimensionne et inclut dans son offre l’ensemble des études d’exécution, fournitures, équipements, accessoires, interfaces, travaux et prestations accessoires, réglages, essais, contrôles, qualifications, documents et autres moyens nécessaires pour atteindre et démontrer les performances et résultats exigés. Pour le lot 3, cette obligation couvre notamment la conception d’exécution, le dimensionnement, la configuration et l’intégration fonctionnelle des isolateurs ainsi que leur compatibilité avec les installations et performances du lot 2. Les solutions proposées respectent les exigences minimales, les contraintes architecturales et techniques, les normes et réglementations applicables, les règles de l’art ainsi que les conditions d’exploitation propres à une pharmacie hospitalière comprenant un environnement contrôlé et une salle blanche. Les travaux seront exécutés dans un environnement hospitalier en activité. L’adjudicataire devra dès lors tenir compte des contraintes spécifiques liées à la continuité des soins, au maintien de l’activité hospitalière, à la sécurité des patients, du personnel et des visiteurs, à la protection des équipements sensibles, ainsi qu’à la limitation des nuisances, poussières, vibrations, interruptions techniques et risques de contamination. L’ensemble des prestations devra être réalisé conformément aux règles de l’art, aux prescriptions légales et réglementaires applicables, aux normes en vigueur et aux exigences propres aux pharmacies hospitalières et aux environnements contrôlés. La salle blanche et les installations qui concourent à ses performances devront être conformes aux exigences définies par l'AR 30/09/2020 Annexes III guide PICS relative à la bonne préparation des médicaments stériles, telles que précisées dans les clauses techniques du marché, ainsi qu’aux instructions du Pouvoir adjudicateur, des auteurs de projet, du coordinateur sécurité-santé et, le cas échéant, des organismes de contrôle. Lot 3 relatif aux isolateurs : La fourniture, l’installation spécialisée, la mise en service et la qualification propre des isolateurs de préparation pharmaceutique font partie du présent marché au titre du lot 3. Les titulaires des lots 2 et 3 coordonnent les réservations, attentes, alimentations, raccordements, évacuations, interfaces avec le traitement d’air et les autres techniques, adaptations constructives, accès de livraison et de manutention, essais intégrés et opérations de qualification.

title: Switzerland – Engineering services – 11797 Hochwasserschutz und Revitalisierung Rot / Soppistigbach, Buttisholz
description: Zusammenfassung: Die vorliegende Submission beinhaltet Ingenieurleistungen gemäss SIA 103, Phasen 31 bis 33 in der Disziplin Wasserbau, d. h. Hochwasserschutz und Revitalisierung an der Rot und am Soppistigbach in der Gemeinde Buttisholz, Kanton Luzern. Hintergrund: Im Jahr 2016 wurde mit der Ausarbeitung eines Hochwasserschutzprojektes begonnen, das die bestehende Kantonsstrassenbrücke über die Rot ersetzen sollte. Im Zuge der Projektausarbeitung wurde der Nutzen einer Erweiterung des Projektperimeters erkannt und mit dem hochwassersicheren Ausbau und der ökologischen Aufwertung von Rot und Soppistigbach weitere Ziel definiert. Inzwischen liegt der Entwurf eines Vorprojekts vor, der jedoch ein ungünstiges Nutzen-Kosten-Verhältnis aufweist und noch mehrerer Anpassungen bedarf. Aufgabe: Anhand der vorhandenen Grundlagen gilt es, zuerst nochmal ein Variantenstudium in der Phase Vorprojekt durchzuführen. Nach der Fertigstellung des Vorprojekts sind Bau- und Auflageprojekt zu erarbeiten. Das Gesamtprojekt ist hierbei in zwei Teilprojekte gegliedert - eines für Wasserbau und eines für Brückenbau. Mit dem vorliegenden Vergabeverfahren werden nur die Planungsarbeiten für das Teilprojekt Wasserbau vergeben. Sobald die Rahmenbedingungen für den Brückenbau definiert werden können, wird das Teilprojekt Brückenbau in einem separaten Verfahren vergeben.
